0022600140.text: The Pelicans (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) host the Denver Nuggets (1-2, on a one-game losing streak) in their fourth game of the season, with New Orleans fifth in the Southwest 3.5 games back and 14th in the West, while Denver sits fourth in the Northwest 2.5 games back and 10th in the West. New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), and Jordan Poole is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Denver won the last meeting 141-135 in Denver on October 24, and the Pelicans trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 0-3 to the Nuggets in 2025-26.
